UI_RemoveLimits_SyncDescription: These controls mirror the current world's Infinite Capacity sandbox settings. In multiplayer, administrators can submit changes to the server; other players follow the server settings.
UI_RemoveLimits_CharacterMode_Tooltip: Controls both the displayed carry capacity and the character inventory pickup limit.
UI_RemoveLimits_CharacterCapacityLimit_T: Used when Character inventory capacity is set to Custom limit.
UI_RemoveLimits_ContainerMode_Tooltip: Choose vanilla capacity, multiply the original capacity, or remove the capacity limit.
UI_RemoveLimits_ContainerMultiplier_Tool: Used when Container capacity is set to Multiplier.
UI_RemoveLimits_AffectBags_Tooltip: Apply the selected container mode to carried and stored bags.
UI_RemoveLimits_AffectWorldContainers_To: Apply the selected container mode to cupboards, crates, furniture, corpses, and other world containers.
UI_RemoveLimits_AffectVehicles_Tooltip: Apply the selected container mode to trunks, glove boxes, seats, and bags stored in vehicles.
UI_RemoveLimits_IgnoreVehicleCargoMass: Vehicle cargo does not add mass
UI_RemoveLimits_IgnoreVehicleCargoMass_T: Items stored in vehicle containers do not increase vehicle physics mass. Installed parts still count.
